fragment:
<set-variable name="userText"
    value="@{
      try {
        var body = context.Request.Body.As(preserveContent: true);
        return body["message"]?.ToString() ?? "";
      } catch { return ""; }
    }" />

  
    {{content-safety-endpoint}}/contentsafety/text:analyze?api-version=2024-09-01
    POST
    
      application/json
    
    
    
      {{content-safety-key}}
    
    @{
      return new JObject(
        new JProperty("text", (string)context.Variables["userText"]),
        new JProperty("categories", new JArray("Hate","SelfHarm","Sexual","Violence"))
      ).ToString();
    }
  

  
  
    <when condition="@{
      var resp = (IResponse)context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("safetyResponse", null);
      if (resp == null || resp.StatusCode != 200) { return false; }
      var analysis = resp.Body.As(preserveContent: true);
      var cats = analysis["categoriesAnalysis"] as JArray;
      if (cats == null) { return false; }
      foreach (var c in cats) {
        if (((int?)c["severity"] ?? 0) >= 4) { return true; }
      }
      return false;
    }">
      
        
        
          application/json
        
        @{
          return new JObject(
            new JProperty("error", new JObject(
              new JProperty("code", "safety_rejected"),
              new JProperty("message", "Your message couldn't be processed. Please rephrase.")
            ))
          ).ToString();
        }
